actions.exact_result_status: Conditional approval of Stormwater Management Permit 2025-004 for temporary laydown/parking, 70.7 acres with 17.5 acres of disturbance; the permit says local MS4 and IDEM construction-stormwater requirements were satisfied subject to pre-construction conditions.
actions.access_caveat: Official permit PDF accessible; it is a temporary stormwater/land-disturbance approval, not a building permit.

actions.exact_result_status: Unconditional approval recorded for MCSD Stormwater Permit 2025-004 after review of the drainage plan and SWPPP.
actions.access_caveat: Official permit PDF; no city-council vote is stated.

actions.body: Indiana Department of Environmental Management, Solid Waste Compliance
actions.exact_result_status: IDEM inspected the construction site in response to a complaint concerning stockpiled/removed soil; the inspection record identifies Project Maize, INX000069115, and says Permit N/A for the complaint inspection.
actions.access_caveat: Official IDEM inspection record; an inspection is not a permit approval.

actions.exact_result_status: IDEM issued a violation letter concerning soil handling at the Project Maize facility; subsequent correspondence and inspection records remain part of the public file.
actions.access_caveat: The letter is reproduced on the city project page; it is an enforcement record, not a project denial.

actions.exact_result_status: IDEM approved the soil sampling and management plan with two changes to analytical constituents and sampling/volume determination requirements.
actions.access_caveat: Date and result are described in the later official correspondence; the underlying December approval is not separately linked.

actions.body: Indiana Department of Environmental Management / project environmental file
actions.exact_result_status: Official correspondence states sampled stockpiled soil decision units met IDEM's uncontaminated-soil policy requirements and could be used as on-site backfill or transported to a designated industrial property.
actions.access_caveat: Official correspondence is accessible; it does not establish Google ownership, energization, or building occupancy.
